name: Jeff Nippard Glute Hypertrophy Program
author: Jeff Nippard
shortDescription: An 8-week program split into two blocks: Accumulation and Metabolic. It focuses on glute hypertrophy through a combination of heavy compound lifts and high-rep isolation exercises.
